reproducer.description: language/mncs/pressure/neighborhood.mncs (4-lane fold, pin nbcounts == 992) at mncs-engine@67c65ba.

requiredBehavior: A uniform-grid or hash-map neighbor query (grid_query(cell) -> lanes) with deterministic iteration order, expressible in bounded MNCS.
summary: MNCS has no map/dictionary/grid structure with deterministic iteration, so mncs-engine neighborhoods cost O(n^2) distance tests: a 1024-lane pool would need ~10^6 tests per step with no structural way down. The 16-lane pool keeps this exact but unscalable.
title: No maps or spatial-index structures (deterministic associative queries)
